title: Aloo Timatar ki Tarkari (Potato and Tomato Curry)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Taught to the author by his sister Atiya when he was in college, and a favorite since. The tomatoes make a thick, tart sauce and the kalonji adds a smoky note. Simple; also good in a baguette sandwich.

steps.action: Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and fry about 1 min, until the cumin starts to darken:

items: 3 medium potatoes (1 lb / 450 g), peeled, in ⅔ in (1.5 cm) cubes
3 medium tomatoes, chopped (or 14 oz / 400 g can)

steps.action: Mix in; cover and cook on medium-low (3/10) 20 min:
Stir; cover and cook 15 min more, adding water if the sauce looks too thick:
items: ½ cup water (120 ml), if needed

steps.action: Test a cooled potato piece; if not done, cook 5 min more and repeat.
